agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.0145) corrupts theta/omega feedback at near-max dt (~0.0194). Controller reacts to noisy measurements with large forces (22-37N), pumping energy (energy ~16 at step 30 rising to ~32 at step 34) into growing oscillations (theta 0.47 at step 20, omega -8 at step 30) until pole whips past 0.8 rad to -0.853 at step 34. Removing only the noise removes the failure.
